control.description-key: FY27 Turn-In entry builder. State path: one or more Prioritizations in the Turn-In state; per Prioritization Funding line (one per Fund/SAG) enter the TDP to turn in and optionally the AFP and Allotment (blank means sized automatically), reducing Itemized Details by each Prioritization total. RF path (NPM): turn in from one Requirement Funding, Withholding first, reducing its Requirement Detail funding by whatever Withholding cannot cover; approved by a Resource Integrator or CSOR. The entry type defaults from the user roles; State users cannot submit an RF-level Turn-In. Bind to book_newamount on the Turn-In form.

property.name: amount
property.description-key: The bound field (book_newamount, Decimal). The control reads and writes the rest of the record via Web API.
